chat.none: No world is active yet, so there is no chat to read or send. Import a world or upload a save on the Worlds page; the first world becomes the active one.
chat.empty: No chat since the server started.
chat.not_running: The server is not running, so no one can read chat. Start it from the Server page.
chat.message.label: Message
chat.message.hint: Players see this in the game as a message from the server. It is recorded in the audit log.
chat.error.control: A message cannot contain a control character, such as a tab
chat.error.long: Enter a message of at most {max} characters
chat.error.nul: A message cannot contain a NUL character
chat.error.lines: A message must be on one line
chat.error.slash: A chat message cannot start with /. To run a command, use the Console.
chat.failure.not_running: The game is not running, so the message was not sent. Start it from the Server page.
chat.failure.unreachable: The game did not answer over RCON, so the message was not sent.
